name: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
notes:
Address/hours from secondary sources, not directly re-confirmed — guggenheim.org's fetched homepage only returned a cookie-consent banner. Geocoding required the abbreviated '5th Ave' form — spelled-out 'Fifth Avenue' matched a generic segment up in Central Harlem instead of this building; same issue hit metropolitan-museum-of-art and neue-galerie (the-jewish-museum, also affected, was removed at user request).

Added 2026-08-19 at user request (major encyclopedic museums batch). Adapter wired 2026-08-19: guggenheim.org runs WordPress with a public /wp-json/wp/v2/exhibition custom post type (confirmed live — real, current titles like 'Taryn Simon | Father Country I Do Love You', 'Carol Bove', 'Guggenheim Pop: 1960 to Now'), same custom-post-type mode already used for nicelle-beauchene. No structured open/close dates in the REST payload or in the page's rendered content (checked directly) — only a broad 'exhibition_year' taxonomy (e.g. '2026', '2027'), so the adapter's generic page-scrape date-range regex will likely come up empty for most records; expect opens/closes null and moderate (~0.45) confidence rather than precise dates. Real titles/excerpts/images/source URLs still land, which is a genuine improvement over manual's empty result.
